subject: Strict semantic-preservation test for the frozen AssertionCarrier v2 on all 34 author-reviewed AHV2-8 source relations.
verdict_rule: FULL iff the frozen predicate family, typed bound source arguments, existing qualifiers, existing structured modifiers, and already-allowed references preserve the core of the reviewed source assertion without strengthening or demoting it. Otherwise GAP, including ambiguity.
hard_rules: Retain exact source relation id, kind, ordered arguments, description and originating claim.
Do not change v2 schema, ClaimIR, admissible target membership or review provenance.

Do not use assertion_scope_qualifiers, binding refinements, or notes as covert carrier fields for the missing direction, mapping, evidence status, modality, statistical significance, ordering or other core relation.
Do not treat a node labelled response_or_outcome as L_sys when its defined referent is a model-fit comparison or other claim-level analytic result.

L_claim source-argument or semantic-reference binding remains restricted by frozen v2 to nodes which really are THEORETICAL_ACCOUNT; do not retype fit statistics, model-based interpretations or observed neural signals as accounts.
Source 'requires' expresses necessary-condition force; DEPENDENCE alone is insufficient when that necessity is the central source claim.
An inferred cognitive mechanism must remain distinguished from empirically measured model fit and cannot silently be presented as observed cognition.
A strong or statistically significant association is not identical to bare association when that statistical qualification is explicitly part of the source assertion.
NEGATIVE (a flat negation) cannot represent 'need not' (absence of necessity or sometimes-absence) without overstatement.

For multi-outcome ordered comparisons, a single directionality.target_argument is insufficient if several outcomes share the asserted comparative direction and no typed bindings can preserve the joint order.

A source assertion about an initial-to-final transition must preserve both endpoints. Single-valued INCREASES or DECREASES is not a substitute unless the claimed transition truly concerns only a single increasing/decreasing target.
The same-assistant adjudication is a semantic audit with chronological source hold-out, not an independently blinded external review.

available_resource_semantics.TRANSFORMATION: Can model explicit input/output transformations and mapping, but cannot alone assert an untyped qualitative operation or membership relation not present in its bindings.
available_resource_semantics.DISTINCT: Can distinguish objects/conditions or outcomes under COMPARISON; it is not a blanket marker for asymmetry of modal possibility or inverse relationships.
available_resource_semantics.directionality: One typed target can indicate INCREASES, DECREASES, or OPPOSITE_DIRECTION only when causal/predictor anchor is fully recoverable from source argument roles.
available_resource_semantics.evaluation: Only with COMPARISON, dimensions EVIDENTIAL_SUPPORT or EMPIRICAL_FIT and preferred argument from the original source arguments.
available_resource_semantics.semantic_references: Only existing omitted ClaimIR nodes, with existing reference roles and correct L_sys/L_ctx/L_claim binding restrictions.
available_resource_semantics.scope: Only incidental background, source population/context, explicit model-relative assumption or condition already scoped by its typed references; never an untyped extra predicate/modifier.
available_resource_semantics.candidate_possible: A tentative/possible claim is not equivalent to a specific probabilistic or modal negation (e.g., 'need not').
